newsitem.title: FINLAND: Outokumpu partly offsets Nokia-led Helsinki bourse fall.
newsitem.headline: Outokumpu partly offsets Nokia-led Helsinki bourse fall.

text.p: Finnish shares ended lower in fair volumes on Thursday with a fall in telecoms group Nokia only partly offset by a new year-high for metals group Outokumpu after it reported above-forecast interim earnings, brokers said.
The FOX stock futures index closed down 0.69 percent at 1,055.21 and the HEX all-share index fell 0.63 percent to 3,057.64. Volume was a whisker over 500 million markka.
The sentiment was subdued by Nokia's fall after an overnight slide for its ADR on Wall Street, and by nervousness ahead of the release of U.S. May payrolls and unemployment data on Friday.
"Many big institutional investors have been clearly on the sidelines today due to jitters ahead of Friday's data," one broker said.
Nokia recovered some early losses to end 5.50 markka or 1.6 percent down at 339.40 markka.

Favourable metal market trends and the stronger dollar boosted Outokumpu's four-month earnings by 65 percent on the year-ago period, and brokers saw further upside for the share, particularly due to a brighter outlook for zinc prices.
Forest shares also bucked the general trend, gaining 0.3 percent on the sub-index. UPM-Kymmene rose 1.10 markka to 119.60 markka.
